verdict.rationale: Warp documents automations: cloud agents run from triggers and schedules, and individual runs are tracked and reviewable through transcripts. However, nothing in the evidence describes versioning automation definitions, reviewing changes to them, or rolling them back. Run-transcript review is an adjacent capability about inspecting executions, not managing automation versions, and the one-line "factories as code" marketing claim does not document versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
